title: Pronunciation/transliteration support per phrase
context: Responders and newcomers often cannot read the target script, so each translated phrase gains pronunciation/transliteration support to enable spoken first-contact. A qualified reviewer verifies the transliteration. It depends on the first translated pack.
objective: Add pronunciation/transliteration support for each phrase in a translated pack.
acceptanceCriteria: Each phrase gains a transliteration/pronunciation field in a documented scheme
Transliteration reviewed and signed off by a qualified speaker of the target language
Preserved tokens (numbers, units, emergency number) remain exact in the transliterated form
Validates against the pack/phrase schema and passes CI structural checks
